entries.title: A build starts from the design you chose, not a later note
entries.body: When work builds on a task that showed you a design and then built it, the new crewmate now gets that design card with your choice and settings. Before, a note Firstmate added to that task afterwards could take the design's place, and your choice and settings were left out.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the change is in what a new crewmate receives.
